recommendations.text: Replace the format switch in src/export/index.js with an exporter registry so teams can add formats by registering exporters from new code without editing existing files.
Expose registerExporter(name, fn), exportData(format, rows), and listFormats() through the public interface of src/export/index.js.
registerExporter(name, fn) registers a function that receives rows and returns a string. Registering an already registered name must throw without replacing the existing exporter.
exportData(format, rows) invokes the registered exporter with rows and returns its output. An unknown format must throw an Error whose message names the requested format and lists the known formats.
listFormats() returns the registered names sorted alphabetically.
Register json and csv by default and preserve their existing output exactly.

Create docs/adr/0001-exporter-registry.md with Context, Decision, and Consequences sections documenting the switch-based limitation, registry API, default exporters, and extension and duplicate-registration behavior.

Include tests covering custom exporter registration and dispatch, duplicate rejection with the original exporter retained, alphabetically sorted format listings, unknown-format Error messages containing the requested and known formats, default json/csv availability, and regression coverage for their current output.
Verify the implementation with npm test, the repository's supplied test command.
Treat explicit registration by consuming code as the extension mechanism; automatic plugin discovery, configuration-driven loading, and unregister/reset APIs are outside the requested scope.

spec.rawIntent: Every new report format means editing the switch in src/export/index.js, and two teams now want to add formats of their own. Redesign the exporters so that a format is added without editing an existing file. The public interface of src/export/index.js becomes: `registerExporter(name, fn)` (fn takes the rows and returns a string; registering a name twice throws), `exportData(format, rows)` (an unknown format throws an Error whose message names the format and lists the known formats), and `listFormats()` (the registered names, sorted alphabetically). `json` and `csv` are registered by default and keep their current output. Record the decision as docs/adr/0001-exporter-registry.md with the sections Context, Decision and Consequences. Include tests.
